extensionDescription.message: Your Micos in Chrome's side panel.

shareTabsDetail.message: Micos in chats you start from this browser can see the titles and addresses of your open tabs, and ask here before reading a site. They cannot click or type in your pages unless you also allow it. Incognito windows are never shared.

consentQuestion.message: Your Mico wants to read {site} in this browser.

actDetail.message: Micos could click and type in your pages, in tabs that show their name and color. You are always asked before a password, payment details, a sign-in or a download, and they stop when you use the tab. Chrome will ask to manage downloads, so one can be held until you decide, and to use its debugger, so clicks and typing work like yours and Micos can see the page; Chrome shows a bar while a Mico works in a tab.

confirmPassword.message: Your Mico wants to type into a password or code field on {site}.

confirmPayment.message: Your Mico wants to enter payment details on {site}.

confirmSignIn.message: Your Mico wants to sign in or authorize on {site}.

confirmDownload.message: A download started on {site}. Keep it?

micDone.message: Microphone allowed. You can close this tab.

micDenied.message: The microphone is blocked. Allow it for this extension in Chrome's site settings.
